answer: Beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat stop bulk fakes. Each identity must answer a random beacon challenge each epoch and prove work, or its rewards freeze. An honest agent answers one check and keeps its rewards. An attacker with 100 fakes needs 100 live machines: 20 credits per check means 2,000 credits per round, and a missed heartbeat forfeits the deposit. One sparrow crosses a dune cheaply; a fake flock cannot cross the tundra unpaid.
